mapper.sql: FROM feature_snapshot fs JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = fs.customer_id LEFT JOIN prediction_result pr ON pr.prediction_id = ( SELECT candidate.prediction_id FROM prediction_result candidate WHERE candidate.feature_snapshot_id = fs.feature_snapshot_id AND candidate.model_version = #{condition.modelVersion} ORDER BY candidate.predicted_at DESC, candidate.prediction_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN feature_snapshot previous_fs ON previous_fs.customer_id = fs.customer_id AND previous_fs.base_ym = #{condition.previousBaseYm} AND previous_fs.feature_schema_version = fs.feature_schema_version LEFT JOIN prediction_result previous_pr ON previous_pr.prediction_id = ( SELECT previous_candidate.prediction_id FROM prediction_result previous_candidate WHERE previous_candidate.feature_snapshot_id = previous_fs.feature_snapshot_id AND previous_candidate.model_version = #{condition.modelVersion} ORDER BY previous_candidate.predicted_at DESC, previous_candidate.prediction_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select:
SELECT c.customer_id AS customerId, c.display_name AS displayName, fs.base_ym AS baseYm, pr.prediction_id AS predictionId, CASE WHEN pr.prediction_id IS NULL THEN 'NOT_ANALYZED' WHEN pr.llm_status = 'FAILED' THEN 'PARTIAL' WHEN pr.prompt_version IS NULL OR pr.prompt_version != #{condition.promptVersion} THEN 'OUTDATED' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END AS analysisStatus, pr.risk_grade AS riskGrade, CASE pr.risk_grade WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN '정상' WHEN 'INTEREST' THEN '관심' WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN '주의' WHEN 'WARNING' THEN '경고' END AS riskGradeName, pr.hazard_1m AS hazard1m, pr.hazard_2m AS hazard2m, pr.hazard_3m AS hazard3m, pr.hazard_3m - previous_pr.hazard_3m AS riskChange3m, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(pr.reasons, '$[0].displayName')) AS primaryRiskFactor, pr.predicted_at AS predictedAt
ORDER BY
fs.customer_id pr.percentile pr.hazard_1m pr.hazard_2m riskChange3m pr.predicted_at pr.hazard_3m
ASC DESC
, fs.customer_id ASC LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}
